correctness.rationale: The exact normal form follows since X^2=h(y)^2=0 iff ord_y(h)>=ceil(n/2), while Y^n=(n mod2)x f^{n-1}g forces g(0)=0 only for odd n; for n>=3 the tangent determinant is j(0)f'(0). Nakayama gives exactly the automorphisms. Free-coefficient counting gives (G_m)^2 x A^{3n-4+floor(n/2)+1_even} for the reduced variety and (q-1)^2 q^d finite-field points. Derivations constrain neither D(x) nor D(y) in even n, and constrain the two constant-y-degree components of D(y) for odd n: dimensions 4n, 4n-2; dimension excess floor(n/2)+1 is unbounded. n=2 excluded. Independent brute-force F2 data: n=3:64, n=4:2048, n=5:8192, n=6:262144 and tangent dimensions 10,16,18,24; the symbolic relation argument, not the finite checks, proves every field/size.
residual_risks: No finite computation establishes infinite-parameter coverage; the reconstructed algebraic proof supplies the stated general scope.
